items.question: How much money has the UAE allocated to the NAFIS Emirati Talent Competitiveness programme?
items.fact: NAFIS allocated AED 24 billion for Emirati employment

items.question: How many Emiratis does the NAFIS programme aim to employ in the UAE private sector by 2025?
items.fact: NAFIS targets at least 75,000 Emiratis employed by 2025
